scripts.infra:destroy: pnpm run infra:destroy:dev && pnpm run infra:destroy:stg && pnpm run infra:destroy:prod
scripts.infra:destroy:dev: RUN_TYPE=DESTROY pulumi up -y -s dev && pulumi destroy -y -s dev
scripts.infra:destroy:prod: RUN_TYPE=DESTROY pulumi up -y -s prod && pulumi destroy -y -s prod
scripts.infra:destroy:stg: RUN_TYPE=DESTROY pulumi up -y -s stg && pulumi destroy -y -s stg
scripts.infra:up: pulumi up -y -s dev && pulumi up -y -s stg && pulumi up -y -s prod
